description: Variance components from AGENCY_LMM_FULL_ALL_DATA (all 2006-2014 data). Agency ICC reflects residual agency clustering after adjusting for all fixed effects. Comparison to locked AGENCY_LMM_FULL (2006-2012 only) provided for reference.

locked_agency_lmm_full_variance_componen.note: From AGENCY_LMM_FULL fit on 2006-2012 training data only.

interpretation: Agency ICC = 0.2632 in the all-data refit. This indicates that agency identity accounts for approximately 26.3% of total variance in log_wp after adjusting for all fixed effects. Comparison locked value (2006-2012 only): ICC=0.2422. Differences reflect training-period composition and should not be over-interpreted.
